subject.title: fix(browser): close tracked tabs after gateway restart

question: Should OpenClaw persist and later close ownership-verified tabs from existing-session and remote-CDP profiles after a Gateway restart, or keep those profiles process-local despite the cleanup leak?
rationale: Current main uses an in-memory registry, while this PR deliberately adds durable state and changes what may be closed after restart in shared browser configurations; that lifecycle policy is not resolved by correctness tests alone.

options.title: Approve durable ownership cleanup
options.body: Accept the restart-persistent policy for ownership-verified tabs and continue normal compatibility review before merge.

options.title: Limit durable cleanup
options.body: Restrict persistence to managed profiles and leave existing-session and remote-CDP tracking process-local until a narrower policy is agreed.

recommendation.title: Approve durable ownership cleanup
recommendation.body: Accept the restart-persistent policy for ownership-verified tabs and continue normal compatibility review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work in the session-tab registry area makes this the strongest available routing candidate.
